description: Charleroi - Réseau cyclable existant is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville de Charleroi. Réseau cyclable existant et identification du gestionnaire (Ville ou SPW). Coverage: Charleroi. The portal files it under Mobility. Its keywords are vélo, mobilité, doux, mobilité, pist, cyclable. The portal shows 285 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2022-06-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
